selection_policy.current_rule: largest-remainder constraint-count quotas; round-robin exact signatures in seeded hash order; requires a distinct similar match
selection_policy.similar_rule: identical sorted constraint IDs (including count); highest normalized prompt word-set Jaccard within remaining signature pool; no topic-similarity threshold
selection_policy.regression_rule: same constraint count; disjoint constraint families (prefix before colon); exclusive bipartite matching
selection_policy.deduplication: global source key and NFKC/casefold/whitespace-normalized prompt
selection_policy.tie_break: sha256(seed:ordering_attempt:key); first feasible ordering, at most 256
selection_policy.note: AER adaptation/validation subset of official test data; holdouts are acceptance data, not an independent final test. Regression tasks need not pass the initial prompt.
